summary: Build stakeholder influence, negotiation, and trust skills in 5 days. Apply practical tools and secure agreements with confidence.
lede: Negotiation and influence without formal authority help professionals secure agreement and move work forward across teams, vendors, and governance groups. It is designed for project managers, business analysts, procurement specialists, and other professionals who need commitment without controlling reporting lines or decisions. Participants learn to map stakeholder interests, prepare negotiation positions and concessions, handle resistance with persuasive messaging, and record agreements for follow-up.
audienceIntro: This Negotiation and Influence Without Authority Training is built for professionals who must secure agreement across functions, departments, vendors, and governance layers without formal reporting power.
prerequisites: Participants should bring working experience in cross-functional work, meetings, or project delivery where agreement must be built without direct line authority. A basic familiarity with stakeholder management, meeting facilitation, and workplace communication is helpful. No coding is required, and no prior negotiation framework knowledge is assumed, although participants who already manage procurement, change, project, or operations discussions will find the applied exercises especially relevant. Advanced concepts such as BATNA, power-interest analysis, and coalition building are taught at an operational level, with emphasis on practical use rather than theory.
